correctness.rationale: All 120,465 augmented faces enumerated with a separately computed deletion-contraction matching polynomial. All 120,465 face Hasse nodes and every cover are included in an acyclicity check. The resulting 5x47 and 47x1 signed integral Morse boundary matrices are recomputed from gradient recursion, with explicit determinant -1, primitive 7-cell vector and zero chain composition. Homotopy elimination is justified by the degree classification of maps S5-> wedge S5 and S6->wedge S6, not by Betti counts alone. Finite graph exhaustive only; no unsupported infinite claim.
